question: Does the first natural five-gate targeting teacher reproduce on an independent population, and can a search-free student learn its decisions across different source effects?
collect: 2048 fresh natural v14 games, seeds 89100000..89102047. Alternate frozen teacher A/B by game index. Log all own-target comparisons T7-12 on each teacher's own trajectory, including every abstention. For every option, supervise conservative simulated improvement over original target divided by max(10, effect magnitude), minus 0.20; incomparable targets are negative. No test seeds in training.
fit: Separate students, 1024 assigned games per arm split by game (every fifth for calibration). Only public card description token and mechanism features, actual target and original target stats, relative retention, legality, current state and original policy probabilities; no source ID as input. MLP 64/32 SiLU, AdamW 0.001, 18 epochs, Huber beta 0.10, positive alternatives oversampled. Calibration chooses largest beneficial count among thresholds -0.10 to 0.30 with at least 70% precision and eight beneficial calls; otherwise abstain. Audit a separately refitted student on unseen source-card bucket. All identities and choices frozen before final outcomes.
replication: 512 fresh common natural v14hold game seeds 89300000..89300511. Run parent, both previously frozen teachers and both new no-search students. Report D-128's five gates, T12 survival and P50/n, full rank and utility, actually changed games and sources. No choice between endpoints after looking. A small targeted gain alone does not establish an economically meaningful general-purpose long-training method.
